# Fixtures

Real Soroban contract WASM artifacts used by the integration tests.

## test_soroban.wasm (633 bytes)

- Source: minimal `hello` contract generated by `stellar contract init`
- Built with: stellar-cli 28.1.0 (`stellar contract build`), soroban-sdk 28.0.0
- Target: `wasm32v1-none` (Soroban standard target)
- Contents: 1 exported function (`hello(to: String) -> Vec<String>`), imports `b::i`, `v::g`
  (env host functions), custom sections `contractenvmetav0`, `contractmetav0` ×2,
  `contractspecv0`

## soroban_diff_b.wasm (749 bytes)

- Source: modified contract — `hello(to: Symbol)` (param type changed) plus added
  `goodbye(name: String) -> String`
- Built with: stellar-cli 28.1.0 (`stellar contract build`), soroban-sdk 28.0.0
- Target: `wasm32v1-none`
- Purpose: exercise spec-level compatibility diff (breaking param change +
  non-breaking function addition)

Both fixtures are the smallest practical real-contract artifacts; committed as
binaries intentionally for test stability.
